newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Moldova 1996 GDP, industrial output down eight pct.
newsitem.headline: Moldova 1996 GDP, industrial output down eight pct.

text.p: Moldova's gross domestic product dropped by eight percent in 1996 from 1995 levels, the State Statistics Department said. GDP fell three percent in 1995.
The Statistics Department said industrial output was also eight percent short of 1995 levels, compared to a four percent fall the previous year.
Moldova's agricultural production fell by 13 percent in 1996 after growth of four percent in 1995.

The average monthly salary in Moldova in 1996 was 186 lei ($40). The report said Moldova had 23,400 registered unemployed, or 1.8 percent of the total labour force, as of January 1, 1997. --Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
